plugins.name: ai-search-audit-plugin
plugins.description: Comprehensive AI Search Visibility Audit and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) skill. Audits websites and brands for AI search dominance across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot. Analyzes technical foundations (robots.txt AI crawler access, llms.txt implementation, JSON-LD schema markup, structured data), content extractability (answer-first structure, FAQ optimization, TLDR patterns), entity authority (Knowledge Graph presence, sameAs linking, topical coverage depth), multi-model optimization (ChatGPT citation patterns, Perplexity source attribution, Gemini paragraph extraction, AI Overview inclusion), brand mention tracking, citation rate measurement, Share of Model scoring, and competitive benchmarking. Generates scored audit reports with prioritized optimization roadmaps. Covers the full spectrum from technical SEO-for-AI to content strategy for generative engine visibility.
